name: skill-update
description: Keep skills copied from git repositories up to date in any folder: finds where each came from, flags risky changes, merges your own edits, backs up every replaced file and logs every update.

interface.shortDescription: Update copied skills from their repositories, keeping your edits
interface.longDescription: Finds every skill in a folder, sub-folders included, records the repository and commit each one was copied from, and updates them with a three-way merge that keeps your own edits. Every replaced file is backed up and every update is listed in a dated Markdown log.
defaultPrompt: Update my skills and keep my edits.
Record where this skill comes from.
